name: Chromaveil-TC
description: A Tessera Materials thermochromic polymer film built on a layered cholesteric liquid crystal matrix with programmable transition thresholds, allowing precise color-change responses across a 15–120°C range in user-defined palettes. Unlike earlier thermochromic coatings, Chromaveil-TC supports multiple simultaneous color bands, gradient transitions, and can be calibrated to shift at body-temperature deltas as small as 0.3°C. Applied as a spray-on coat, adhesive film, or woven into Veilweave textiles.
cost: Φ 45 per kg (film) / Φ 12 per m² (spray-grade)
story_hooks: A witness's Chromaveil-TC jacket recorded a heat event — forensic analysis of the color pattern reveals someone was running a plasma cutter in the supposedly empty room.
A Tier 1 gang uses knock-off Chromaveil-TC as crude gang markings that only appear when members are running hot — adrenaline and exertion make them visible.
A diplomat's Chromaveil-TC garment is broadcasting their stress response to anyone who knows what to look for — they're being read like an open book.
